== Summary ==
Page 31 of 40 (ship-docking, vehicles and capacity of starships) of '''''The Rules''''', the ''Star Wars Customizable Card Game'' rulebook packed in [[Premiere Limited|Premiere]] starter decks (© 1995 Decipher Inc.; printed in Belgium by Carta Mundi). Document page: [[Premiere starter deck rulebook]].

Source: the right half of <code>Rulebook_15_p30-31.tif</code> (a 600 dpi two-page spread, SHA-256 <code>af2e9857b7c91c89d1adef1787c6d27d85f0840ef73244cfa8a077b0cb0c1a8e</code>) in the folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/15MVULZxbmcEeBmBOToMO1axiH2zLUUKW Rulebook (from Premiere Starter Deck)] of the public "SWCCG Scans" Google Drive folder (owner not shown), uploaded to Google Drive in April 2024 (file date 21 April 2024). Preserved copy of the folder: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261112195026/https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/15MVULZxbmcEeBmBOToMO1axiH2zLUUKW Internet Archive]. Cropped at the spine and saved as lossless PNG at the original resolution (1469 × 2067 pixels); no other changes.

Used on [[Premiere starter deck rulebook]].
